_comment: Outcome cards that collapse a family of catalogue readouts into one card, because each readout alone is a measurement code a reader cannot interpret. Each finding keeps its own trait string in its details. Matching is exact (or an exact prefix), never fuzzy. Added 2026-11-08 from the HG002 render: 715 Affymetrix expression cards (all EWAS Catalog PMID 33752734) and 34 NMR panel codes (all from PMID 33413638's 57 trait strings, listed here verbatim from the EWAS mirror).
